discrepancy_report.analysis: The prose statistics are internally inconsistent: 0.5002 ETH x 3,867 = 1,934 ETH, which is neither the documented 1,827.63 ETH total nor the measured 1,861.29 ETH. They were almost certainly computed from a drifting, unpinned scan -- the exact §6.3 TRAP 2 failure mode. The measured values here reproduce all three onchain aggregate invariants bit-for-bit at a pinned block, so they are the ones to test against. The documented harmonic mean also fails its own cross-check: acquisitionFee / 1.1 at block 25612701 is 0.12387 ETH, not 0.1247 ETH.
